MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: Manufacturing for this product has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to the P145 and P14NB with HID relays.
heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: The MIB, a member of the M II family of economical and highly functional digital protection relays, is a microprocessor based relay that provides three phase high impedance differential protection for Substation Bus-bars of any voltage level.
heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: Use the MIB also to protect electrical machines like transformers, generators or motors against restricted earth faults.
heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: Basic protection functions features include a high impedance differential protection unit with a tripping time of 1 1/2 cycles. Stability against external faults is guaranteed thanks to the use of a stabilizing resistor. The unit includes a set of MOVs (Metal Oxide Varistors) provided to clamp the secondary peak voltage below 2kV during fault conditions.
heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: The relay includes open CT detection which provides an alarm when it detects sustained current unbalance conditions, issuing a warning signal and blocking the operation of the unit.
heading: MIB High Impedance Busbar Differential Relay

text: Configurable logic, curves, I/Os and LEDs

text: Automatic display of last fault information

heading: Features & Benefits

text: Differential protection for single and split busbar arrangements.
heading: Applications

text: Zero sequence differential (restricted ground fault) protection for reactors, generators, large motors, and other power apparatus

text: 6 outputs, four configurable, plus trip and alarm
